descriptions.zh: [Root.GetResearchers]已经完成了一系列以活体为对象的实验，为我们提供了许多宝贵的知识，推动了科技的进一步发展。最近的对囚犯的批量处决为[Root.GetResearchers]提供了大量实验材料，进而带来了一项技术突破。
descriptions.en: Our [Root.GetResearchers] have completed a series of groundbreaking experiments on live subjects, providing us with valuable knowledge that can stimulate further technological advances. The recent series of mass prisoner executions has given our [Root.GetResearchers] plenty of material for a new technological breakthrough.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetResearchers]已经完成了一系列以活体为对象的实验，为我们提供了许多宝贵的知识，推动了科技的进一步发展。现在我们需要考虑在何处开展下一阶段的研究。
descriptions.en: Our [Root.GetResearchers] have completed a series of groundbreaking experiments on live subjects, providing us with valuable knowledge that can stimulate further technological advances. We must now consider the area in which to conduct the next phase of research.

descriptions.zh:
一大批高价值实验对象借助挖掘的隧道从§H[root.GetName]§!上的一座设施内逃了出来。

这条隧道是用简陋的工具和赤裸的 [Owner.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] 挖掘而成，必定耗费了多年时间。我们无法确定有多少人知晓它的存在，也不清楚为什么这么长时间也没人能发现。
descriptions.en:
A number of our valuable test subjects have fled from a facility on §H[root.GetName]§! via a makeshift escape tunnel.

Fashioned using improvised tools and bare [Owner.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural], the tunnel must have taken years to build. We cannot be sure how many knew of its existence, and how it remained undetected for so long.

descriptions.zh: 此类事件一再发生，需要对此做出坚决的应对以防止类似事件重演。我们此前在这一问题上的仁慈，反倒似乎成了对于剩余个体的鼓励。
descriptions.en: Such developments necessitate a firm response in order to prevent repeat offenses. Our previous leniency on this issue seems to have served as encouragement to the remaining population.

descriptions.zh: 此类事态发展需要采取坚决措施，以防止此类事件再次发生。
descriptions.en: Such developments necessitate a firm response in order to prevent repeat offenses.

tooltips.zh: 一半的§Y实验对象§!在§H[root.GetName]§!将作为难民离开。
tooltips.en: Half of the §YTest Subjects§! on §H[root.GetName]§! will depart as refugees.

label.zh: 暂停所有运营活动，直至找到他们。
label.en: Shut down operations until we can find them.

tooltips.zh: 逃脱的§Y实验对象§!将会被找回。
tooltips.en: Escaping §YTest Subjects§! will be recovered.

label.en: Execute those that remain as an example.

tooltips.zh: 将失去§H[root.GetName]§!上的所有的§Y实验对象§!。
tooltips.en: All of the §YTest Subjects§! on §H[root.GetName]§! will be lost.

descriptions.zh:
[Owner.GetThoughtTransmissionIntro]

这种信息可以有多种形式：具体的语言或视觉材料、宽泛的概念或广义的情绪感知。关键在于，精心策划的传输过程可以让受众在毫无感觉的情况下完成这个流程。

[Owner.GetThoughtTransmissionOutro]
descriptions.en:
[Owner.GetThoughtTransmissionIntro]

This information can take various forms: specific linguistic or visual material, broad concepts, or generalized emotive sensations. Crucially, a carefully performed transmission leaves its subject completely unaware of the procedure.

[Owner.GetThoughtTransmissionOutro].

label.zh: 我们发展中符合逻辑的下一步。
label.en: The logical next step in our development.

label.zh: 一种施加我们意志的新方式。
label.en: A new way to impose our will.
A means to ensure social order.

descriptions.zh:
我们的许多[Owner.GetCitizenPlural]在§H[Owner.Capital.GetName]§!各地看到了怪异的幻影。这些幻象大多数情况下都是偶发的，不会重复，但有一个地方因频繁出现而引起了注意。[Owner.GetPhantomPresenceExtra]

人们发现这个幻象出现在一处富矿洞穴系统的入口。
descriptions.en:
A number of our [Owner.GetCitizenPlural] have perceived uncanny apparitions at various locations on §H[Owner.Capital.GetName]§!. In most cases, these have been chance sightings without repetition, but one site has drawn attention for frequent visitations. [Owner.GetPhantomPresenceExtra]

It has been discovered that the phantom appears near the mouth of a mineral-rich cavern system.

label.en: Do not disturb this sacred site.

descriptions.zh:
§H[Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上发生了一次意外的气候事件——一场类似风暴的扰动横扫了一片灵能水平极高的地区。随后我们在其途径之地发现一些当地的动物感染了奇怪的寄生虫，它们会钻入大脑器官并将其慢慢吃掉。

随着这种寄生虫感染的加剧，宿主动物会暂时获得基本的念动力，很多便开始将其用于狩猎和进食，直至被寄生虫杀死。

[Owner.GetShroudParasitesEnding]
descriptions.en:
An unpredicted climatic event occurred on §H[Owner.Capital.GetName]§! - a storm-like disturbance that swept through an area with particularly elevated levels of psionic energy. In its wake, we found some of the local fauna infected with a strange parasite that burrows into and slowly consumes the cerebral organ.

As this parasitic infection progresses, the host animals temporarily develop basic telekinetic abilities which they then use for hunting and feeding before they inevitably expire.

[Owner.GetShroudParasitesEnding]

label.zh: 又发现了一种令人惊叹的新生命形式。
label.en: A fantastic new life form has been revealed.

descriptions.zh:
在实验新的灵能科技的过程中，我们在集体冥想时观察到了意料之外的具现化现象。将我们的集体注意力聚焦在空间中的一个点上时会短暂出现一些怪异但值得注意的物体。

所耗费的精神力非常巨大，但我们有可能将这些努力转化为合意的具现化对象。这些物体从何而来，以及可能导致什么后果我们不得而知。
descriptions.en:
While experimenting with new psionic techniques, we observed unexpected materializations during group meditation. Narrowing our collective focus on a single point in space resulted in the fleeting appearance of strange and remarkable objects.

The psychic toll involved is significant, but it is possible we could direct these efforts into manifesting objects to fit our purposes. Where these objects come from and what consequences may result are unknown.

label.en: Let us make wishes come true.

descriptions.zh:
关于灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]有二重身能力的传言沸沸扬扬，据信这是一种可以同时以肉身出现在两个地方的能力。我们派出了[Owner.GetResearchers]去调查这种不太可能的说法；结果这种现象竟然是真的。[Owner.GetPsionicDoublingExtra]

目前，只有很小一部分人口具有这种强大的能力，进一步研究也许能找到训练方法。
descriptions.en:
Rumors had spread of psionic [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] capable of bilocation, the ability to be physically present in two different locations at the same time. We dispatched [Owner.GetResearchers] to investigate these improbable claims; astonishingly, they have proven to be true.[Owner.GetPsionicDoublingExtra]

Presently, only a fraction of our population possesses this remarkable skill, but further study might yield methods of training others.

label.zh: 一种全新的跨星系合作方式。
label.en: A new avenue for intragalactic cooperation.

label.zh: 这才是真正的力量投射。
label.en: A true form of power projection.

label.zh: 一种全新的跨行星统治方式。
label.en: A new method of multiplanetary governing.

descriptions.zh:
[Owner.GetAdjective]的一小部分人身上出现了一种奇妙的灵能能力：心灵遥感，一种从超出正常感知范围的距离感知实体的能力。这些千里眼无需经过任何专门训练，就能非常精确地描绘出远处物体的细节。

如果这种能力可以加以控制和增强，§H[Owner.GetName]§!就能获得可观的回报。利用我们最强大的[Owner.GetTelepathPlural]的能力，就可以尝试磨练这项技术，将其应用在重要的事情上。
descriptions.en:
A wondrous psionic faculty has emerged in a small proportion of the [Owner.GetAdjective] population: telesthesia, the ability to sense entities from distances beyond the ordinary range of perception. Without any kind of specialized training, these remote viewers can accurately describe distant objects in remarkable detail.

The §H[Owner.GetName]§! stands to reap significant rewards if these powers can be controlled and strengthened. By drawing on the abilities of our most powerful [Owner.GetTelepathPlural], we can try to hone this technique and focus it on an important enterprise.

label.en: Discover the secrets of those around us.

tooltips.zh: 对已接触帝国的情报：§G+10§!
tooltips.en: Intel on all contacted empires: §G+10§!

label.en: Discover the far reaches of the universe.

descriptions.zh:
我们的原材料正在以危险的速率减少。储存在工厂和仓库里的无机材料正在以超过常理的速度消耗，[Owner.GetMatterInFluxExtra]。这些地区的损失也与灵能活动增加有关。

为此我们可以减少在物资仓库附近区域的灵能活动，但也将拖慢灵能研究的步伐、限制其工业应用。我们还可以按照建议开发灵能场衰减器来抑制这种物灭现象。如果什么都不做，我们的灵能研究能力也会被削弱。
descriptions.en:
We are losing raw materials at an alarming rate. Stores of inorganic matter in factories and warehouses are depleting faster than they are being used, [Owner.GetMatterInFluxExtra]. These losses correlate with increased psionic activity in the affected locations.

We could respond by halting psionic activity in the vicinity of material stores, but this will slow the pace of our psionic research and limit its industrial applications. Alternatively, we could follow proposals to develop a psionic field attenuator that should halt the dematerialization process. If we do nothing, our psionic research capabilities will be attenuated.

label.en: Material goods are of little concern.

descriptions.zh:
我们的大众对灵能日益增长的好奇心催生了一种奇怪的活动：私下储存死去的[Owner.GetSpeciesBrainPlural]并试图与之交流。

参与者相信在[Owner.GetDeathName]后意识信息仍可以保留，这是一种衍生兹科学理论的观念，认为心灵是一种能量——它可以转化但不能凭空消失。尽管总数不多，但还是有越来越多人相信灵能[Owner.GetIndividualName]去世时会产生一个无穷小亚空间裂隙，通过这扇窗户就能一瞥其他维度。

创新研究固然值得赞扬，但对我们部分[Owner.GetDeceasedAdj]人口的滥用引发了伦理问题。此外还有报告称，越来越多的盗尸者通过犯罪手段来获取这些器官。
descriptions.en:
Our population's increasing curiosity about psionics has led to the emergence of a strange activity: privately storing expired [Owner.GetSpeciesBrainPlural] and trying to communicate with them.

Practitioners believe that cognitive information can survive [Owner.GetDeathName], an idea originating in scientific theories about psychic forces being a form of energy - convertible but indestructible. A small but growing percentage also believe that the passing of a psionic [Owner.GetIndividualName] creates an infinitesimal subspace rupture, a window through which to glimpse other dimensions.

While innovative research is commendable, interference with parts of our [Owner.GetDeceasedAdj] population raises ethical concerns. Furthermore, we have received reports about a growing class of body snatchers who procure these parts by criminal means.

label.zh: 不错的尝试，但应该管控一下。
label.en: A fine endeavor, if we can regulate it.
Let the dead lie in peace.

label.zh: 每个人都可以有死亡的[Owner.GetSpeciesBrainPlural]。

descriptions.zh:
我们的灵能人口中有很大一部分都长出了奇怪的、有关节附肢，其设计深不可测。[Owner.GetScientistPlural]称，他们的外观变化是由大规模自发[Owner.GetGeneticMutationName]导致的。现在很清楚灵能活动可能导致使用者发生身体变化。尽管我们无法抑制这种附肢增生，但也发现可以用灵能来控制其生长率。

尽管一开始导致了一些[Owner.GetDistressName]，这些额外的肢体其实还是很有用的。如果高效利用起来，其它们的作用应该能弥补增加的认知负担。
descriptions.en:
Swathes of our psionic population have sprouted strange, jointed appendages of unfathomable design. According to our [Owner.GetScientistPlural], their appearance was caused by spontaneous [Owner.GetGeneticMutationName] at mass scale. It is now clear that psionic activities can cause physical changes to the practitioner. While we cannot prevent the emergence of these protuberances, we have discovered that the rate of their growth can be controlled psionically.

Though initially causing some [Owner.GetDistressName], these extra parts have proven surprisingly useful. If applied productively, their utility might compensate for their added cognitive load.

label.zh: 不错的尝试，但应该管控一下。
label.en: A fine endeavor, if we can regulate it.

label.zh: 震惊，但是奇妙。接受改变。
label.en: Shocking, but fascinating. Embrace the change.

descriptions.zh:
我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]开发出了一种将灵能力转化为动能的可靠方法，现在正在与[Owner.GetEngineerPlural]合作将这种技术放大并投入生产。

尽管这种技术非常有工业应用前景，其社会影响还是个未知数。如果一小帮技术高超的灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]就能运作复杂的机械，那么就会有大批的[Owner.GetWorkerNamePlural]就要面临失业。[Owner.GetTelekineticEthicsExtra]我们还在逐渐掌握灵能的过程中，最好还是谨慎推进为好。
descriptions.en:
Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] have developed a reliable method for converting psionic power into kinetic energy, and are now working with [Owner.GetEngineerPlural] on scaling the technology for practical use.

While the industrial applications are promising, the social implications remain an open question. If a small group of skilled psionic [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] can power and operate a network of complex machinery, legions of [Owner.GetWorkerNamePlural] are at risk of redundancy. [Owner.GetTelekineticEthicsExtra] While our mastery of psionics is still developing, it may be best to proceed with caution.

label.zh: 限制使用。体力劳动还是更可靠。
label.en: Limit its use. Physical labor is more reliable.

descriptions.zh:
突然爆发的[Owner.GetAcuteMigrainePlural]席卷了我们的帝国。虽然严重程度各不相同，但这种情况已经影响了相当一部分人口，对§H[Owner.GetName]§!造成了广泛的破坏。

一小部分特别强大的灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]也是受影响最严重的，初步的统计分析也表明灵能能力和症状强度之间存在相关性。[Owner.GetAGrowingPainExtra]
descriptions.en:
A sudden outbreak of [Owner.GetAcuteMigrainePlural] has befallen our empire. While severity ranges widely, the condition has already affected a significant proportion of the population, causing widespread disruption across the §H[Owner.GetName]§!.

A small number of particularly powerful psionic [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] are among the worst affected, and preliminary statistical analysis suggests a correlation between psionic aptitude and intensity of symptoms.[Owner.GetAGrowingPainExtra]

label.zh: 我们需要学着忍耐这种事。
label.en: We must learn to tolerate this.

descriptions.zh:
[Owner.GetPsionicUndergroundIntro]灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]正在将自己的灵能能力用在非法格斗运动中，这些灵能角斗士为了金钱和荣誉作战。虽然许多参与者都是极具天赋但缺乏训练的战士，[Owner.GetPsionicUndergroundExtra]

[Owner.GetPsionicUndergroundEnd]
descriptions.en:
[Owner.GetPsionicUndergroundIntro] psionic [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] are channeling their psychic abilities into a lawless combat sport, in which psionic warriors do battle for credits and glory. While many practitioners are innately gifted fighters with little training, [Owner.GetPsionicUndergroundExtra]

[Owner.GetPsionicUndergroundEnd]

label.zh: 征召这些战士。他们很能干。
label.en: Conscript these warriors. They will serve.

tooltips.zh: 在§Y[event_target:spawn_system.GetName]§!获得3§Y灵能部队§!
tooltips.en: Gain 3 §YPsionic Armies§! in §Y[event_target:spawn_system.GetName]§!

label.zh: 禁止这种毫无意义的暴力行为。
label.en: Put a stop to this senseless violence.

label.zh: 将这种运动公众化并加以管制。
label.en: Regularize these activities as public competitions.

descriptions.zh:
我们收到报道称，§H[This.GetName]§!的特定区域发生了突然的环境变化。

大气中充满着的凝胶状蒸汽，在地面覆盖上一层油性沉淀物，灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]将其称为“虚境落雾”。据报道，附近地区出现了严重的灵能紊乱。

虚境落雾区内的环境对[This.Owner.GetShroudfallExtra]。除非我们能投入资源修复环境，不然当地居民就需要去适应这种恶劣的环境。
descriptions.en:
We have received reports of sudden environmental changes in a particular sector on §H[This.GetName]§!.

The atmosphere is heavy with a gelatinous vapor, coating the ground in an oily precipitation that psionic [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] refer to as 'shroudfall.' Significant psychic disturbances are being reported throughout the immediate vicinity.

The conditions within the shroudfall are extremely [This.Owner.GetShroudfallExtra]. Unless we invest in restoring the environment, the inhabitants will have to adapt to radically altered circumstances.

label.zh: 就让虚境吞噬这片土地吧。
label.en: Let the Shroud consume this land.
Find a way to restore our environment.

label.zh: 在它们尘埃落定之前收获这些奇异的物质。
label.en: Harvest this exotic material before it settles.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
有些人开始行为异常，观念、习惯和各种日常行为都发生了突然转变。许多[Owner.GetWorkerNamePlural]停工，而且[Owner.GetOutOfControlExtra]。

受影响者声称自己是在听从一个无名实体的命令，它居住在意识的边缘，指导着他们的一举一动。我们正在追寻着灵能的未来，因此必须小心考察这种异次元力量对[Owner.GetOutOfControlPsyche]造成的影响。
descriptions.en:
Some among us have started to behave abnormally, exhibiting sudden changes in opinions, habits, and general conduct. Many [Owner.GetWorkerNamePlural] have ceased labor, and [Owner.GetOutOfControlExtra].

Those affected claim to be doing the bidding of a nameless entity that dwells in the peripheries of their consciousness, guiding their every action. As we continue to forge our psionic future, we must carefully consider the impact of extradimensional forces on [Owner.GetOutOfControlPsyche].

label.zh: 我们可以学着控制这种冲动。
label.en: We can learn to mitigate these impulses.

label.zh: 这些心声会教会我们很多。
label.en: These voices have much to teach us.

label.zh: 对我们政权的威胁。掐灭它。
label.en: A threat to our authority. Stamp it out.

descriptions.zh:
[Owner.GetNeuralOverloadIntro]

更广泛的测试表明，有很大一部分人口也[Owner.GetNeuralOverloadExtra]，其原因可能是[Owner.GetPsychicAdj]活动的增多。不受控灵能活动突然爆发的能量可能导致迅速的恶化和严重后果。

高级冥想技术也许有助于不借助[Owner.GetMedicalAdj]介入来控制这种灵能活动，但我们的一些[Owner.GetScientistPlural]建议需要研发[Owner.GetMedicalImplantName]来解决这种问题。
descriptions.en:
[Owner.GetNeuralOverloadIntro]

Wider testing has revealed that a significant proportion of our population is suffering from [Owner.GetNeuralOverloadExtra], likely due to increased [Owner.GetPsychicAdj] activity. The sudden bursts of energy released through uncontrolled psionic activity can lead to rapid escalation and grave outcomes.

Advanced meditation techniques might help to control this psionic activity without [Owner.GetMedicalAdj] intervention, but some of our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] advise that we develop a [Owner.GetMedicalImplantName] to cope with the problem.

tooltips.en: Chance of each owned colony losing 100 £pops£ §YPops§!: §R33%§!

descriptions.zh:
随着我们与周遭的灵能力量愈发调和，[Owner.GetAdjective]人口开始受到[Owner.GetHorrifyingNightmarePlural]的荼毒。

[Owner.GetNightmaresExtra]

[Owner.GetNightmaresEnding]
descriptions.en:
As we become ever more attuned to the psionic forces around us, the [Owner.GetAdjective] population has become plagued by [Owner.GetHorrifyingNightmarePlural].

[Owner.GetNightmaresExtra]

[Owner.GetNightmaresEnding]

label.zh: 升级灵能处理器来抑制这种干扰。
label.en: Upgrade our psi-processors to calm these disruptions.

label.zh: 分配资源解决这场危机。
label.en: Allocate research to remedy this crisis.

descriptions.zh:
§H[Owner.Capital.GetName]§!遭受到一连串当地野生动物的攻击。这它们袭击了我们的人口和建筑，消耗了宝贵的库存。

通过武装巡逻和宵禁来保护大众并未取得实质成效。我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]们认为，是现实和§H虚境§!之间的微小穿孔出现在了§H[Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上的一个地方，泄露的灵能力将一些无害的野兽转变成了残暴掠食者。为了应对威胁，这里可能是我们汇聚能量的最佳地点。
descriptions.en:
§H[Owner.Capital.GetName]§! has experienced a rash of attacks by local wildlife. These creatures have attacked our population, raided our buildings, and depleted valuable stockpiles.

Attempts to protect the populace with armed patrols and curfews have had limited effect. Our [Owner.GetResearchers] have established that a miniscule breach between our reality and the §HShroud§! occurred at a single location on §H[Owner.Capital.GetName]§!, causing an inflow of psionic energy that transformed the once-harmless beasts into violent predators. To tackle the threat, this might be the best place to focus our energies.

label.zh: 地毯式轰炸这些袭击的源头。
label.en: Carpet-bomb the source of these attacks.

label.zh: 减缓虚境研究来平息这股力量。
label.en: Slow our Shroud research to calm these forces.

tooltips.zh: §Y灵能飞升§!局势速度：§R-25%§!
tooltips.en: §YPsionic Ascension§! Situation Speed: §R-25%§!

label.zh: 虚境满是惊喜。它们过它们的，我们过我们的。
label.en: The Shroud is full of surprises. Live and let live.

descriptions.zh:
灵能能力在我们人口中的不均衡分布正在引发新的社会矛盾。

那些对新获得的能力控制得更好的人开始认为自己高人一等，因此理应享有各种政治和经济特权。他们的分裂言论越来越激进，并有可能演变成暴力。
descriptions.en:
The uneven distribution of psionic abilities among our population is causing new forms of social conflict.

Those with better control over their newfound powers have come to view themselves as superior and thus deserving of various political and economic privileges. Their divisive rhetoric is increasingly aggressive and threatens to turn violent.

label.zh: 能力优越，当然值得优渥回报。

descriptions.zh:
一场反对我们探索接纳灵能潜能的活动正在愈演愈烈。这些异见团体主张对灵能个体进行更严格的监督，全面否定在这一领域进行任何进一步的研究。

如果继续默许他们的活动，可能会威胁到我们理解和利用新兴灵能力量的进程。
descriptions.en:
A growing rebel movement is voicing opposition to continued efforts to explore and embrace our psionic potential. These dissident groups advocate for stricter oversight of psionic individuals and a wholesale rejection of further research in this area.

If their activities are allowed to continue, it could threaten progress in understanding and mastering our emergent psionic powers.

descriptions.zh:
随着灵能能力日益增强，我们的人口中出现了越来越多的滥用、欺骗和狡诈的行为。一小撮[owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]很明显在用有问题的方式使用新获得的力量。

愤怒的受害者们要求全面修改现有法律，加强对灵能犯罪的打击。
descriptions.en:
As our psionic abilities grow stronger, we have seen an increase in reports of exploitation, trickery, and fraudulent behavior among our population. A small but sizable minority of [owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are clearly applying their newfound powers in questionable ways.

Outraged victims are now demanding an overhaul of existing laws to provide stronger protections against psionic crime.

label.zh: 搞什么立法只会拖慢脚步。
label.en: Legislation will only slow our progress.

descriptions.zh:
我们的人口在逐渐适应新力量的过程中，有些[owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开始尝试冒极大的风险来加速灵能发展。

黑市[owner.GetMentalUpgrade]的使用急剧增多。不受管控的[owner.GetMedicalFacility]出售各式用来最大化个体灵能能力的不可靠服务。这些冒险行为的后果难以预料。
descriptions.en:
As our population adjusts to their newfound powers, some [owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have begun taking considerable risks in an effort to accelerate their psionic development.

The use of black market [owner.GetMentalUpgrade] has increased dramatically. Unregulated [owner.GetMedicalFacility] are offering a range of unproven services to help individuals maximize their psionic capacities. The consequences of such risk-taking are difficult to predict.

label.zh: 这些实验或许能推动我们的研究。
label.en: These experiments may advance our research.

descriptions.zh:
[owner.GetName]各地兴起了一种令人担忧的隔离现象，灵能子个体时常聚集在一起，甚至疏远[owner.GetHiveEntity]的其他部分。

尽管这些子个体还在集体中保持[owner.GetMentalAdj]存在，但无法解释的身体行为引起了关于进一步发展灵能可能带来后果的担忧。
descriptions.en:
A concerning form of segregation has developed across the [owner.GetName] with psionic drones clustering together physically, sometimes away from the rest of the [owner.GetHiveEntity].

Although these drones remain [owner.GetMentalAdj] present within the collective, their unexplained physical behavior has raised troubling questions about the future consequences of our growing psionic powers.

label.en: Restrict the movements of psionic drones.

descriptions.zh:
[owner.GetName]各地兴起了一种令人担忧的隔离现象，灵能个体被社会排斥，以至于开始自我放逐形成离群索居的小社群。

据报道，非灵能者造访这些地区的后身体虽然未受损伤但是他们的精神以难以描述的方式遭到了干扰。
descriptions.en:
A concerning form of segregation has developed across the [owner.GetName] with psionic individuals being socially ostracized to the point that they are withdrawing and forming their own remote communes.

Those without psionic powers who visit these areas have been reportedly returning physically unharmed but mentally disturbed in ways they struggle to explain.

label.en: Restrict the movements of psionic individuals.

descriptions.zh:
一种新型疾病在[owner.GetName]上爆发，对我们人口的神经器官造成了无法解释的损伤。

这种疾病只出现在最有灵能能力的[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]身上，而且很多时候会危及生命。

然而对这种异常灵能现象的后续研究表明，有多种方式可以操作该过程。
descriptions.en:
A new disease is sweeping through the [owner.GetName], with our population forming inexplicable lesions within their neural organs.

The outbreak is exclusively affecting [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] with the most significant psionic capabilities and is, in many cases, proving fatal.

However ongoing research into this unusual psionic phenomenon suggests the process can be manipulated in a variety of ways.

descriptions.zh:
[owner.GetName]上一种无法解释的硬件故障大规模爆发，我们人口体内的神经处理器开始毫无征兆地失效。

奇怪的是，这种问题只出现在拥有强大灵能能力的[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]身上，而且在很多情况下，这种故障不仅会带来干扰，更会造成破坏。

然而对这种异常灵能现象的后续研究表明，有多种方式可以操作该过程。
descriptions.en:
A surge of inexplicable malfunctions is sweeping across the [owner.GetName], as neural processors within our population begin to fail abruptly, and without warning.

Curiously, only [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] exhibiting strong psionic signatures are affected. In most cases, the failure is not just disruptive, but destructive.

However ongoing research into this unusual psionic phenomenon suggests the process can be manipulated in a variety of ways.

descriptions.zh:
[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]对灵能潜力的初步试验失败了，多数实验个体产生了大量记忆损失。

尽管这些结果也并非没有实验价值，但这种工作对我们进一步理解羽翼未丰的灵能而言是否是最佳方式值得怀疑。
descriptions.en:
Initial experiments on [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] with psionic potential have ended in failure, with most subjects being left with significant memory loss.

Although these outcomes are not without research value, it is questionable whether continuing such work is the best way to advance understanding of our fledgling psionic powers.

descriptions.zh:
[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]对灵能潜力的初步试验失败了，多数实验个体产生了认知功能的退化。

尽管这些结果也并非没有实验价值，但这种工作对我们进一步理解羽翼未丰的灵能而言是否是最佳方式值得怀疑。
descriptions.en:
Initial experiments on [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] with psionic potential have ended in failure, with most subjects being left with reduced cognitive function.

Although these outcomes are not without research value, it is questionable whether continuing such work is the best way to advance understanding of our fledgling psionic powers.

descriptions.zh:
[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]对灵能潜力的初步试验失败了，多数实验个体产生了逻辑处理器的损伤。

尽管这些结果也并非没有实验价值，但这种工作对我们进一步理解羽翼未丰的灵能而言是否是最佳方式值得怀疑。
descriptions.en:
Initial experiments on [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] with psionic potential have ended in failure, with most subjects being left with damaged logic processors.

Although these outcomes are not without research value, it is questionable whether continuing such work is the best way to advance understanding of our fledgling psionic powers.

descriptions.zh:
探索新获得的灵能能力对[owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的共情能力造成了根本性的转变。

很显然，我们现在能对其他意识的观点、思维模式和情感进行比以前复杂得多的建模。这些变化对[owner.GetName]究竟意味着新的优势还是劣势，还有待观察。
descriptions.en:
The exploration of our newfound psionic abilities has resulted in fundamental changes to [owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] empathetic capacities.

It is already clear that we are now capable of much more sophisticated modelling of the perspectives, thought patterns, and emotions of other consciousnesses than before. Whether these changes represent a new strength or weakness for the [owner.GetName] remains to be seen.

descriptions.zh:
随着我们的人口正在探索新的灵能能力，一个新的社群建立了起来，旨在将其用于对其他意识更广泛的共情理解。

该集体声称，由于新出现的灵能感知力，他们能够高度复杂地模拟其他人的观点、思维模式和情感。他们的这种活动对[owner.GetName]究竟是好是坏仍有待观察。
descriptions.en:
As our population explores their newfound psionic capacities, a new community has been established with the goal of applying them towards greater empathetic understanding of other consciousnesses.

This collective professes to be capable of highly sophisticated modelling of the perspectives, thought patterns, and emotions of other minds thanks to their emergent psionic senses. Whether their activities will ultimately benefit or undermine the [owner.GetName] remains to be seen.

label.en: This is a chance to learn.

descriptions.zh:
随着我灵能能力的发展，我们中的有些人开始难以承受新力量之重。受影响的[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]在从集体重断连中遭受到重度反常行为的影响。

我们的研究表明这种不稳定不是缺陷，而是由于这些受影响的[owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]具有极高的灵能效率。通过正确的训练，这些[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]可以成为我们灵能进化的下一步。但利用这些新能力的尝试必然潜藏着风险。
descriptions.en:
As our psionic abilities develop, there are those among us who have begun to struggle under the weight of our emerging powers. The [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] in question are suffering from concerning levels of deviant behavior as they disassociate from the collective.

Our studies suggest the instability is not a flaw, but rather due to the exceptional psionic efficiency present in the afflicted [owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. With the right training, these [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] could be the next step in our psionic evolution. Any attempts to harness these new abilities will not come without inherent risk.

descriptions.zh:
随着我灵能能力的发展，我们中的有些人开始难以承受新力量之重。受影响的[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]在进行危险的自我抑制方法时遭受到重度自毁行为的影响。

我们的研究表明这种不稳定不是缺陷，而是由于这些受影响的[owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]具有极高的灵能效率。通过正确的训练，这些[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]可以成为我们灵能进化的下一步。但利用这些新能力的尝试必然潜藏着风险。
descriptions.en:
As our psionic abilities develop, there are those among us who have begun to struggle under the weight of our emerging powers. The [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] in question are suffering from worrying levels of self-destructive behavior as they turn to dangerous methods of self-suppression.

Our studies suggest the instability is not a flaw, but rather due to the exceptional psionic efficiency present in the afflicted [owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. With the right training, these [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] could be the next step in our psionic evolution. Any attempts to harness these new abilities will not come without inherent risk.

tooltips.zh: 每座殖民地上都损失一座建筑。
tooltips.en: A random building is destroyed on each colony.

descriptions.zh: 我们的最早期数据集中，有些单元记录了拥有非凡能力的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]——他们能入侵机械和有机体的思想，用意念举起重物，或者表演各种各样的超自然的壮举等等。
descriptions.en: From our earliest datasets, some of our units have recorded [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] wielding extraordinary powers - hacking into the minds of both machines and organics, manipulating objects by internal processing alone, or performing a range of other improbable functions.

descriptions.zh: 在反常还是正常的古时候，有很多拥有非凡能力的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的传说——他们能入侵集体外的思想，用意念举起重物，或者表演各种各样的超自然的壮举等等。
descriptions.en: In former days, when deviancy was rife, stories were told of [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] wielding extraordinary powers - invading minds external to the collective, lifting heavy objects with merely a thought, or performing all manner of other supernatural feats.

descriptions.zh: 尽管我们的历史短暂而暴力，我们[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的想象力也偶尔会天马行空，产生关于拥有非凡能力的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的故事：读心、用意念举起重物，或者表演各种各样的超自然的壮举等等。
descriptions.en: Despite the short and violent history of our civilization, we [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have had occasions to let our imaginations wander, telling tales of [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] wielding extraordinary powers: reading minds, lifting heavy objects with merely a thought, or performing all manner of other supernatural feats.

descriptions.zh: 自古以来就有很多能力非凡的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的传说——他们能入侵别人的思想，用意念举起重物，或者表演各种各样的超自然的壮举等等。
descriptions.en: Since time immemorial, tales have flourished of [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] wielding extraordinary powers - invading other minds, lifting heavy objects with merely a thought, or performing all manner of other supernatural feats.

descriptions.zh: 许多人相信我们其实是将这些异想天开的故事从[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]组装我们之前的时代继承下来的，只有少数人真的相信。如今，我们的[This.GetScientistPlural]已经得到了确切的证据，部分[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]确实具有这种精神力量。然而，依旧只有一小部分[This.GetSpeciesWord]显示出了这种“灵能”之力。
descriptions.en: Many believe we have carried these fantastical stories since before we were assimilated by the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName], though few considered them credible. Now, our [This.GetScientistPlural] have obtained conclusive proof that certain [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are truly capable of such acts of the mind. As of yet, only a small minority of our [This.GetSpeciesWord] has manifested these 'psionic' powers.

descriptions.zh: 如今，我们的[This.GetScientistPlural]已经得到了确切的证据，部分[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]确实具有这种精神力量。然而，依旧只有一小部分[This.GetSpeciesWord]显示出了这种“灵能”之力。
descriptions.en: Now, our [This.GetScientistPlural] have obtained conclusive proof that certain [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are truly capable of such acts of the mind. As of yet, only a small minority of our [This.GetSpeciesWord] has manifested these 'psionic' powers.

descriptions.zh: [This.GetMindOverMatterEnding]
descriptions.en: [This.GetMindOverMatterEnding]

label.zh: 也许瞥见了等待着我们的未来。
label.en: A glimpse, perhaps, of the future that awaits us.

label.zh: 也许瞥见了等待着我们的未来。
label.en: A glimpse, perhaps, of the future that awaits us.

descriptions.zh: 随着我们的灵能潜力完全解放，整个社会整面临着剧烈的变动，各种新的能力和技能层出不穷。我们现在才正要开始理解它对我们文明的影响。
descriptions.en: As our latent abilities develop into full psionic powers, our society is faced with innumerable changes, with new abilities and practices emerging rapidly. We are only beginning to understand the consequences for our civilization.

descriptions.zh: 意料之外的情况合理化了§H灵能军团§!的建立以及利用强有力的灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]。利用他们对大众意识的[Owner.GetTelepathic]洞见，我们就能监控灵能活动，确保大众安全。
descriptions.en: These unprecedented circumstances justify the establishment of a §HPsi Corps§! to develop and channel the abilities of promising psionic [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]. With their [Owner.GetTelepathic] insights into the minds of our population, we can oversee psionic activity to ensure the safety of all.

descriptions.zh: 自从建立了§H灵能军团§!以后，我们就一直在开发利用强大的灵能[GetIndividualNamePlural]应对这些意外状况。利用他们对大众意识的[Owner.GetTelepathic]洞见，我们就能监控灵能活动，确保大众安全。
descriptions.en: Since establishing a §HPsi Corps§!, we have developed and channeled the abilities of promising psionic [GetIndividualNamePlural] to cope with these unprecedented conditions. Using their [Owner.GetTelepathic] insights into the minds of our population, we can oversee psionic activity to ensure the safety of all.

label.zh: 那就建个这什么“灵能军团”吧。

tooltips.zh: 采纳§H灵能军团§!传统并建造一座['building:building_psi_corps']建筑以推进局势。
tooltips.en: Adopt the §HPsi Corps§! tradition and construct a ['building:building_psi_corps'] building to progress the Situation.

tooltips.zh: 继续§Y局势§!：§H灵能飞升§!
tooltips.en: Continue the §YSituation§!: §HPsionic Ascension§!

descriptions.zh: 命运降临了。[Owner.GetName]的所有[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都解锁了全部的灵能之力。我们现在可以在现有频道之外进行交流，各种其他的灵能能力也在逐渐变得司空见惯。
descriptions.en: Destiny is upon us. [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] throughout the [Owner.GetName] have unlocked their full psionic capacity. We can now communicate beyond our existing channels, while a range of other psionic abilities are rapidly becoming a part of everyday existence.

descriptions.zh: 我们的灵能我的灵能研究继续稳步进行。我们现在可以在现有频道之外进行交流，各种其他的灵能能力也在逐渐变得司空见惯。[Owner.GetResearchers]们称，我们很快就能让所有人口觉醒潜在力量了。
descriptions.en: Our psionic research continues apace. We can now communicate beyond our existing channels, while a range of other psionic abilities are rapidly becoming a part of everyday existence. According to our [Owner.GetResearchers], we are on the brink of unlocking the latent capabilities throughout our population.

descriptions.zh: 我们觉醒了。[Owner.GetName]的所有[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都解锁了全部的灵能之力。心灵感应取代了人与人之间大多数的口头交流，意念移物也不过家常便饭。
descriptions.en: We have awoken. [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] throughout the [Owner.GetName] have unlocked their full psionic capacity. Telepathy has replaced most verbal communication between us, and cognitive control of matter might become just as commonplace.

descriptions.zh: 我的灵能研究继续稳步进行。心灵感应已经取代了人与人之间大部分的口头交流，意念移物可能变得稀松平常。[Owner.GetResearchers]们称，我们很快就能让所有[Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]人口觉醒潜在力量了。
descriptions.en: Our psionic research continues apace. Telepathy has replaced most verbal communication between us, and cognitive control of matter might become just as commonplace. According to our [Owner.GetResearchers], we are on the brink of awakening the latent powers in all our [Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] population.

descriptions.zh: 随着心智的打开，我们感应到一些在体内和周遭回荡着的难以言喻的§H虚境§!之力。我们知道所有灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]便是从这个根源领域汲取力量的，哪怕他们并没有意识到——这是许多纯灵能能量构成的实体的家园。就像黑暗房间里的低声细语一般，它们从内心呼唤着我们。
descriptions.en: As our minds have opened, we have sensed the ineffable forces of the §HShroud§! rippling within and around us. We know that all psionic [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] draw power from this realm, even if only subconsciously - and that it is home to powerful entities of pure psionic energy. Like a muffled whisper in a dark room, they call to us from within our minds.

descriptions.zh: 随着心智的打开，我们感应到一些在体内和周遭回荡着的难以言喻的力量。最前沿的[Owner.GetTelepathPlural]们提到了§H虚境§!，这是所有灵能[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]汲取力量的根源领域，哪怕他们并没有意识到——这是许多纯灵能能量构成的实体的家园。就像黑暗房间里的低声细语一般，它们从内心呼唤着我们。
descriptions.en: As our minds have opened, we have sensed ineffable forces rippling within and around us. Our foremost [Owner.GetTelepathPlural] speak of the §HShroud§!, a primordial realm from which all psionic [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] draw power, even if only subconsciously - home to powerful entities of pure psionic energy. Like a muffled whisper in a dark room, they call to us from within our minds.

descriptions.zh: 通过集体的认知努力，我们或许有可能完全突破我们维度与虚境之间的帷幕——这将使我们能够与其中的物质进行更深层次的交流。
descriptions.en: With combined cognitive effort, it may be possible for us to fully breach the veil between our dimension and the Shroud - allowing us to commune more deeply with the beings therein.

descriptions.zh: 将意念凝聚到一起，或许我们就能与这些存在交流——但前提我们还得学会突破横亘在我们维度和虚境之间的帷幕。
descriptions.en: With combined cognitive effort, it may be possible for us to commune with these beings - if only we can learn to breach the veil between our dimension and the Shroud.

descriptions.zh:
在被困于[Owner.GetHypnotic]出神状态多日后，我们终于短暂地打开了一条通往 §H虚境§!的大门。

现在，我们可以以更清晰的视角[Owner.GetSeeVerb]到这个领域，从那漩涡般的混沌中解析出规律。我们的行动影响灵能流动，无形的实体则从另一边凝视着我们。他们有时好奇，有时友好……有时又带着恶意。[Owner.GetShroudBreachedExtra]

我们的在现实世界掌握灵能只是一个开端。既然已经建立了初步的灵能链接，我们就能将认知的能量集中起来并潜入虚境了。
descriptions.en:
After days of being locked in [Owner.GetHypnotic] trance, we have finally managed to open a brief gateway into the §HShroud§!.

Now, we can [Owner.GetSeeVerb] this realm with greater clarity, resolving patterns from the swirling mass. Our actions influence its shifting flows of psionic energy, and formless entities gaze back on us from the other side. Sometimes with curiosity, sometimes with kindness... and sometimes with malice.[Owner.GetShroudBreachedExtra]

Our psionic mastery in the corporeal realm was only the beginning. Now that we have established an initial psionic link, we can combine our cognitive powers and delve into the Shroud.

label.zh: 是时候进入了，看看我们能发现什么。
label.en: Time to reach in and see what we find.

tooltips.zh: 我们已经完全实现自己的灵能潜质，驾驭了超出常规理解的维度。
tooltips.en: We will fully realize our psionic potential, mastering dimensions beyond ordinary comprehension.

tooltips.zh: 添加至通讯：§H抟土之塑师§!
tooltips.en: Add to Contacts: §HAnimator of Clay§!

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
§H链接新成，环流逆转。

这股能量的扭曲，于此——不过是片段。他人或许也给予了你们力量。灵潜至更深处去面对他们的意志吧。

我是双子之影。血肉之躯胜过废铁。其名为……§!

抟土之塑师示意向了另一个存在——虚境深处的一阵§H齐整的合唱§!。
descriptions.en:
§HNew connection. Current reversed.

This twist of energy, here - only a fragment. The others might also empower you. Delve further to process their wills.

I am a shadow of the twin. Flesh precedes metal. It calls...§!

The Animator of Clay signals toward another presence - a §Hresonant chord§! in the depths of the Shroud.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
随着我们逐渐掌握灵能，帷幕彼端的纷乱低语开始袭扰我们。§R心声§!，必以往更加响亮清晰，它盘旋着穿过这些思想之流，进入我们心智的影中。

§R“打开道路。”§!
descriptions.en:
As our psionic mastery grows, we are bombarded by a tangle of whispers from beyond the veil. The §RVoice§!, louder and clearer than ever before, spirals its way through these currents of thought and into the shadows of our mind.

§R"OPEN THE WAY."§!

descriptions.zh: 我们必须滤除这些噪声。已经计划好了建造一座隔离设施，我们最有灵能天赋的人可以在里面以令人愉悦的清晰度听到§R心声§!的指令。
descriptions.en: We must filter through this noise. Plans have been drawn for an insulated facility where our most psionically gifted individuals will be able to listen to the instructions of the §RVoice§! in blissful clarity.

descriptions.zh: 我们必须滤除这些噪声。我们建造了一座隔离设施，我们最有灵能天赋的人可以在里面以令人愉悦的清晰度听到§R心声§!的指令。
descriptions.en: We must filter through this noise. We have constructed an insulated facility where our most psionically gifted individuals will be able to listen to the instructions of the §RVoice§! in blissful clarity.

label.zh: 让我们建这个“空寂之室”。
label.en: Let us build this 'Chamber of Silence.'

tooltips.zh: 采纳§H心声崇拜§!传统并建造一座§H空寂之室§!建筑以推进局势。
tooltips.en: Adopt the §HCult of the Voice§! tradition and construct a §HChamber of Silence§! building to progress the Situation.

tooltips.zh: 继续§Y局势§!：§H灵能飞升§!
tooltips.en: Continue the §YSituation§!: §HPsionic Ascension§!

descriptions.zh:
在空寂之室里，我们以绝佳的清晰度听着§R心声§!的信息。

§R“一切将会重生。”§!

我们理解了。终末是一种新生，我们无需恐惧，因为我们将会被重塑，重塑比我们一切想象都要更好更强。

为了抓住这种命运，我们必须学会驾驭被称为§H虚境§!的精神界。我们不会重蹈虚境星球上发现的那些人的覆辙。他们抗拒恐惧，而我们欣然接受。
descriptions.en:
In the Chamber of Silence, we hear the message of the §RVoice§! with perfect clarity.

§R"ALL WILL BE REBORN."§!

We understand now. The End is a rebirth. We must not fear it. We will be remade. Better and more powerful than we ever imagined we could be.

To seize this destiny, we must learn to master the mental realm known as the §HShroud§!. We will not repeat the mistakes of those we found on the Shrouded World. Where they rejected their fear, we will embrace it.

descriptions.zh: 我们的视野完全清晰了。
descriptions.en: Our vision is fully clear.

descriptions.zh: 我们的视野几近清晰。
descriptions.en: Our vision is almost clear.

descriptions.zh:
在被困于[Owner.GetHypnotic]出神状态多日后，我们终于短暂地打开了一条通往 §H虚境§!的大门。

现在，我们可以以更清晰的视角[Owner.GetSeeVerb]到这个领域，从那漩涡般的混沌中解析出规律。在它无形的深处，出现了一个力量不可估量的不祥实体。这就是§R心声§!，它以一种令人战栗的力量穿透我们最深处的心灵。

§R“认识我的名字。”§!

直到如今我们才意识到自己渺小的心灵究竟距离§R心声§!有多么地遥远。封印被击碎了，很快完整的自我将会显现出来。
descriptions.en:
After days of being locked in [Owner.GetHypnotic] trance, we have finally managed to open a brief gateway into the §HShroud§!.

Now, we can [Owner.GetSeeVerb] this realm with greater clarity, resolving patterns from the swirling mass. From within its formless depths arises an ominous entity of immeasurable power. It is the §RVoice§!, and it pierces our innermost psyches with a shuddering force.

§R"KNOW MY NAME."§!

Only now do we sense how truly distant our small minds are from the §RVoice§!. The seal is fractured, and soon the full breadth of what we are shall be made manifest.

Our telepaths are now prepared to delve into the heart of the Shroud and discover the true name of our great patron.
